data.narrative:
DNA Script is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public-market peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, with 3 same-stage private comparables anchoring the peer-median approach.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression, using the $200M total raised as a proxy baseline, applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, yielding $340M. Peer-median anchoring uses 3 same-sector, same-stage companies—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B)—producing a median valuation of $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; the sector's median P/S multiple is 6.6x across the 3 public tickers, but DNA Script's revenue is not disclosed, preventing ratio application.

The two applicable methods produce a wide dispersion: stage-progression implies $340M, while peer-median implies $3.8B. The triangulated range spans $289M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The wide spread reflects uncertainty around the appropriateness of the peer set—particularly whether Colossal's outlier $10.3B valuation reflects comparable stage maturity or market conditions. Absent revenue data, public-market anchoring cannot reduce this range. A valuation between $1.5B–$3.0B would reconcile the peer median with stage-progression conservatism, though peer composition and undisclosed operational metrics remain material uncertainties.
